verdict.rationale: Visa documents agent-specific network tokens instead of raw PANs. Purchase-intent mandates carry an amount cap (declineThreshold) and an expiry (effectiveUntilTime), and can be cancelled. Credential retrieval is bound to a declared merchant and amount, and VisaNet enforces at authorization that the request comes from the intended merchant for the correct amount. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped tokens are actually issued and enforced in production, and a mature, generally available release (the docs say the product 'is in the process of development and deployment').
